mike: quick sync on the stale-read we saw during demote+evict. minimal timeline: O1 starts demote(epoch=19) -> accepts write W (inflight) -> slab reclaim evicts prefix -> demote completes -> O2 takes epoch=20 and serves read -> pre-W value returned.

tara: thanks. so demote can finish while writes are only in O1 RAM. that breaks our post-handoff causal guarantee.

sasha: thought: instead of forcing a full WAL step on demote, what if we do a tiny two-phase demote: prepare (publish a delta-checkpoint manifest + soft-fence) then commit. Prepare is a metadata write with digest+counts; old owner best-effort flushes deltas to local staging and pins. New owner on takeover checks for manifest; if present and verified it proceeds, else it queries old owner or stalls. Commit can be implicit after a timeout or explicit once staging is durable.

lee: so prepare == lightweight fence, commit == durable guarantee. That lets us offer modes: fast-prepare-only (lower latency but needs RPC or stall on fail) and prepare+commit (slower but strict). Nice.

mike: key constraints: manifest must be idempotent and cluster-observable (control-plane metadata store). staging flush is best-effort but we record a flush_hint in manifest so new owner knows what to expect. If old owner crashes after prepare but before commit, new owner must either block reads for that prefix or trigger read-repair from the backing store. For rollout, block-by-default.

tara: telemetry: demote_prepare_published, demote_commit_observed, demote_prepare_latency, demote_reconcile_rpc, demote_blocked_reads. Also add a per-prefix handoff_trace_id.

sasha: tests: add chaos job "demote-prepare-crash" that forces demote+evict+crash with slow inflight writes; assert no stale reads when prepare+commit enabled and no stale reads when prepare-only but RPC reconciliation allowed.

lee: ops knobs: default = prepare+block (strict tenants). opt-in = prepare-only + best-effort RPC fallback (lower latency). Soft-pin memory impact should be gated by a canary flag.

mike: action items: 
- mike: prototype prepare-manifest + soft-pin + simple staging hint and unit tests (ETA: EOW)
- sasha: draft control-plane manifest API and durability modes (ETA: 3d)
- lee: add telemetry + canary flag + dashboard (ETA: 2d)
- tara: runbook update for crash/timeout fallback (ETA: 1d)

opsbot: created ticket IR-12864: "demote-prepare-manifest-handshake" and added test-case demote-prepare-crash.

mike: will open PR and link the ticket. blocking-by-default for strict tenants; we can relax later. closing thread.
